verdict.rationale: ByteAsk shows diffs for review before applying changes and supports multiple concurrent sessions via `/agents` (session command center) and `byteask queue` for messaging a running session, but it is documented as a terminal (TUI) product, not a desktop GUI app, and there's no evidence of a visual side-by-side session layout. Missing for 10: confirmation of a true desktop app UI, visual diff rendering beyond terminal text, and an actual side-by-side multi-session view.
